PR-01.help: Search the register before adding; each person is registered once only

PR-04.label: Age group
PR-04.help: Auto-calculated: registration year − PR-03. Bands combine to the framework's 25–35 (impact) and 25–45 (other indicators)

PJ-02.label: Date the proposal was approved for implementation

AC-02.label: Activity category
AC-02.help: Choose the category that matches the indicator the activity reports to

AC-04.label: Date held / start date

AC-07.label: Approved project this programme is tailored to

AC-08.label: Training content was jointly developed with

PA-02.help: If the person is not found, register them in FORM-01 first

form.noneExclusive: "None" cannot be ticked with another answer.

form.stampedOnSave: Recorded when the survey is saved.
form.calcOnSave: Worked out from the year of birth when the record is saved.
form.notAsked: Not asked for the answer chosen.
form.activityFirst: Choose the activity first: the questions depend on its category.
form.onFile: On file — the name is locked.
form.newPerson: Not on file — a new person will be registered.
form.nidInvalid: A national ID is exactly nine digits.
form.personLocked: The person cannot change on a saved registration.
form.alreadyRegistered: This national ID is already in the register.
form.registrationDeleted: This person's registration was deleted. It is restored from its page, never entered again.
form.personDeleted: This national ID belongs to a person who was deleted. A coordinator restores them; they are never entered again.
form.coordinatorOnly: Only a coordinator can restore a person.

picker.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded.
picker.surveyed: Networking events and employability trainings only: this survey asks about those.

form.notFound: This record no longer exists or is not yours to edit.
form.unknownColumn: The form sent a field the database does not know ({column}). This is a defect in the form.

rule.not_applicable: {label}: belongs to an answer that is not chosen; leave it empty.
rule.not_registered: {label}: this person is not in the Person Register (FORM-01). Register them there first.
rule.deleted: {label}: the record chosen has been deleted.
rule.in_use: {label}: cannot change, because participation or feedback has been recorded for this activity.
rule.none_exclusive: {label}: "None" cannot be ticked with another answer.
rule.not_surveyed: {label}: this survey asks nothing about this kind of activity.
rule.locked: {label}: cannot change on a saved registration.
rule.person_deleted: {label}: belongs to a person who was deleted.

constraint.rmth_participation_once_per_activity: This person is already recorded on this activity.
constraint.rmth_feedback_once_per_activity: This person has already answered for this activity.
constraint.rmth_activity_end_after_start: The end date cannot be before the start date.
constraint.rmth_followup_first_placement_by_followu: The first placement date cannot be after the follow-up date.
constraint.rmth_followup_continuous_by_followup: Working continuously since cannot be after the follow-up date.
constraint.rmth_followup_income_months_of_six: Months with income is from 0 to 6.
constraint.rmth_activity_contact_hours_positive: Contact hours must be more than zero.
constraint.rmth_activity_sessions_positive: Sessions delivered must be more than zero.
constraint.rmth_beneficiary_year_of_birth_four_digi: The year of birth is four digits.
constraint.national_id_format: A national ID is exactly nine digits.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this record? It stops counting and can be restored later.
detail.deletedNote: This record is deleted and does not count. A coordinator can restore it.

publish.note: Published activities appear on Ramtha's public page with their category, type, sector and dates, until the day after they end. A business incubator stays listed while it is published.

thresholds.title: Open items
thresholds.intro: The definitions the Calculation Method sheet marks REQUIRES CONFIRMATION and leaves open. Each is a value the indicator views read; while it is empty the indicator that depends on it is not computable — never zero. A coordinator writes the decision here, with the date; nothing else changes.
